name: team-messaging
description: Team agent messaging: a poll-mode channel MCP server, Stop and SessionStart hooks that wake the session for new messages, and join/bind/status/watch skills.

broker_url.title: Broker URL
broker_url.description: HTTPS broker URL (plain HTTP only on loopback). Written by team-messaging join or bind.

token_file.title: Credential file
token_file.description: Path of the mode-0600 credential file; the token itself is never stored in plugin configuration.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace this session is bound to.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Topic this session is bound to; empty for a workspace-level binding.

session_id.title: Pinned session ID
session_id.description: Broker session shared by the MCP server, hooks and watcher.

mode.title: Delivery mode
mode.description: poll (default); push only when started with the development channels flag.

arm.title: Watcher arm
arm.description: rewake (Stop hook wakes an idle session), bash (skill-started background watcher) or off. Changing it needs a Claude Code restart.
